preconditions: source layer identity and provenance are recorded
feature and orientation counts are known
requiredEvidence: true dip, dip direction and angular uncertainty for every direct observation
decisionLogic: DirectFieldMeasurement and DigitizedSourceMapOrientationSymbol may become direct constraint candidates
MappedContactDemPlaneFit and SyntheticAssumption remain diagnostic only
layers with NoOrientationSemantics cannot declare orientation records
uncertainty: Every direct observation must carry an explicit non-negative angular uncertainty.
exclusions: DEM-fitted contact planes as measured orientations
validationMethod: positive, negative, boundary, missing-data and out-of-scope unit tests
reopenCondition: Add a new structural observation basis or orientation representation.
